subject: C2a3 proposed funding policy and fixed1024 scan256F price addendum r1

findings.summary: The first fixed debit does not prepay its own caller-side work or refusal path.
findings.details: Construction of the first WorkCost, argument evaluation, call transport, and an immediate question-mark refusal occur before the proposed fixed charge succeeds. The ledger counts this caller-side work, while MODEL.md excludes only the charge and ledger implementation bodies and explicitly retains the caller tuple and question-mark. Neither the fixed allowance nor its error reserve therefore funds this temporal prefix.
findings.requiredCorrection: Either explicitly review and extend the trusted-metering boundary to the initial debit's caller-side construction, transport, and immediate refusal propagation, distinguishing it from later charge calls and removing excluded nodes from the ledger, or prove a previously paid enclosing allowance covers that prefix. Reconcile MODEL.md, ERROR-PREFIX.md, CALL-TREE.json, LEDGER.json, formulas, and controls with the selected boundary. Raising the later fixed debit alone is insufficient.

evidenceLimitations: The supplied checker and report were inspected but not executed under the request's no-execution boundary.
The review is limited to the funding-price addendum and does not resolve the separately owed complete-M obligations.
The internally consistent 781 fixed and 163 per-blob totals do not establish coverage of work that runs before the first successful debit.
